decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - 4	The proposed AC unit and associated condenser will not operate before 08.00am Monday - Saturday and not after 19.00 Monday Friday and at no time on Sundays.

Condition : 4 - The noise generated from the proposed air conditioning conensor unit, shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq), when measured from the nearest residential property, over any 24 hour period. For the purpose of any assessment, the nearedt residential property is likely to be a flat in the first floor of the building.
description: Internal refurbishment and shopfit inclusive of new airconditioning and associated condenser
